hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Vox has intensified its 29N campaign with sharp anti-immigration rhetoric and remigration messaging across Spain. Tensions boiled over in Sabadell as a Vox rally was violently disrupted by protesters throwing stones, while Pedro Sánchez repeatedly targeted Vox during national television debates.
hotspots.affect: The combination of physical street clashes in Catalonia and high-profile political demonization in election debates generates maximum grievance and outrage framing.

hotspots.title: RN Headquarters Raided in State Leaks Probe
hotspots.blurb: French judicial authorities raided the headquarters of Rassemblement National and the Interior Ministry over alleged leaks of confidential state files to Marine Le Pen's party. A former prefect is under investigation for passing sensitive judicial and police intelligence to RN officials ahead of the 2027 presidential cycle.
hotspots.affect: The dramatic physical police search of a major opposition headquarters combined with state-security breach allegations creates intense institutional scandal and political panic.

hotspots.title: AfD Pushes Early Premier Vote in Saxony-Anhalt
hotspots.blurb: AfD candidate Ulrich Siegmund has accelerated plans to force an early Minister-President vote in Saxony-Anhalt on December 8 in an effort to overturn state broadcasting treaties. Simultaneously, AfD and BSW secured controversial appointments to the state's Verfassungsschutz intelligence oversight panel.
hotspots.affect: AfD's move to capture intelligence oversight while demanding immediate executive power triggers severe democratic alarm among establishment parties.

hotspots.title: Moraes Bars Allied Visits to Imprisoned Bolsonaro
hotspots.blurb: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes scheduled a December 4 vote on the 'Dosimetria' law that could alter Jair Bolsonaro's prison term, while maintaining strict bans on political allies visiting him. Defense attorneys for Bolsonaro have appealed the restrictions, denouncing the isolation of the former president.
hotspots.affect: The strict judicial oversight of Bolsonaro's physical custody feeds a deeply emotional narrative of political persecution and judicial overreach among his followers.

hotspots.title: Kaczyński Demands Strict Terms for Constitutional Reset
hotspots.blurb: PiS leader Jarosław Kaczyński declared he will reject any constitutional reset regarding the Constitutional Tribunal unless Prime Minister Donald Tusk agrees to a presidential technical government. Tusk swiftly rejected the ultimatum, prompting fierce rhetoric from PiS leaders accusing the government of state censorship.
hotspots.affect: Kaczyński's hardline demands escalate constitutional brinkmanship, framing the governance deadlock as an existential struggle over legal legitimacy.
